$comment: 收据:本仓库哪些数字可复现、哪些明确不可复现。核对于 2026-09-13。规则:凡对外宣称的量化结论,要么在这里给出可跑的命令,要么明确标注不可复现——不允许既不标来源也不标不可复现。每条 claim 的 check 由 .github/workflows/claims.yml 每周跑一次。

claims.claim: The test suite passes on a clean checkout.
claims.method: node --test over the repo's test files (package.json scripts.test -> scripts/run-tests.js).

claims.claim: Lint is a hard gate: ESLint runs with --max-warnings=0, so a single warning fails.
claims.method: package.json scripts.lint is exactly 'eslint . --max-warnings=0'; scripts.check runs lint then test.

claims.claim: The Agent-vs-Legacy Q&A benchmark table in README.md / docs/agent-qa.md is a directional historical record and is NOT reproducible.
claims.metric: both documents carry the staleness warning (counts, one per file)
claims.method: Both documents already carry the warning: the harness lived in an untracked eval/ directory and used private archive data, and the numbers predate the block-level BM25 rewrite. No number in that table is asserted as current.
claims.repro: grep -c '已过期且不可复现' docs/agent-qa.md && grep -c 'stale and not reproducible' README.md

check.manual: no committed artifact can recompute 20.5s / 10.1s: the harness that produced them lived in eval/, an agent scratch directory removed as untracked in ee2a63d, and it ran against a private Weibo group archive (56 days of one group, not in the repo). The numbers also predate the block-level BM25 retrieval rewrite and the pi-agent-core loop migration, so re-running anything today would measure different code — that is why README.md and docs/agent-qa.md both label the table stale, and why current numbers must come from scripts/benchmark-qa.js instead.

claims.claim: Current latency numbers can be produced locally by the shipped script instead of being quoted from the stale table.
claims.metric: script exists and carries the 4 documented flags
claims.method: docs/agent-qa.md documents --group / --repeat / --questions / --json; README points at it for current numbers.
